data.name: Dipraj
data.gender_notes: Dipraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dipraj is a compound name in Hindu mythology. 'Dip' means 'light' and 'Raj' means 'king' or 'rule'. Thus, Dipraj signifies the 'King of Light' or the 'God of Wisdom and Prosperity'. The name Dipraj carries the meaning “God of Wisdom and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Dipraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dipraj represents enlightenment and knowledge. It is a powerful name believed to bestow wisdom and intelligence upon the bearer. It is also believed to bring prosperity and success.
data.etymology: Dipraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dipraj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

The name Dipraj is also used for other deities associated with light and knowledge, such as Agni, the god of fire, and Savitri, the goddess of the sun. In Hindu rituals and festivals, the name Dipraj is often invoked to symbolize the presence and power of the revered gods, especially during the rains and festivals related to them.

It represents the divine spirit of light that illuminates our path and bestows upon us wisdom and prosperity. The significance of the name Dipraj extends beyond just the literal meaning.
